Case reference: 2013000021.CaseDesc: Bones of a right foot with its sock and shoe were found along the bank of the Ottawa river in Gatineau, Quebec.

Sridhar left behind his Indian passport, wallet, banking cards and identification.  Sridhar speaks English and is known to travel on foot. They left the convenience store around 3:00 p.m., and were then seen in a Prévost, Quebec area restaurant. Nadine's vehicle had not moved from the restaurant between the evening of June 16, 2004 and the time Dominic Gauthier's mother reported their disappearance on June 18, 2004.

Case reference: 2012020049.CaseDesc: William Krowchuk was last seen leaving his residence in Saskatoon, SK, around 10:00 p.m. on July 9, 1998. The vehicle he was driving at the time of his disappearance was located on July 14, 1998, in the downtown area of Saskatoon.

Right Large Toe, No toe nail

Case reference: 2014004043.CaseDesc: On March 8, 2002, Eva Nakanjako, her husband Robert Mukwaya, and their son Emmanuel Mukwaya were last seen in Toronto, Ontario. Eva and Robert had not shown up for work for three weeks and had not paid their rent. During the time of their disappearance, their apartment was found partially emptied.

Case reference: 2014001943.CaseDesc: Kam Lee was last seen in the Bishop Grandin Highway and River Road area of Winnipeg, Manitoba. Kam's current whereabouts are unknown.

Case reference: 2018035793.CaseDesc: On June 25, 2018, Desmond Fischer was seen for the last time as he left his residence to go for a walk in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan. Desmond is known for following a very strict routine, and his disappearance is out of character.

Case reference: 2007005499.CaseDesc: Lindsey Nicholls was 14 years old when she disappeared in 1993. She left the group home where she was living in the Comox Valley, BC at about 10:30 a.m. after having an argument with her foster mother. She was last seen walking away from the residence to visit some friends in Courtenay. She left all of her belongings and treasures in her room; she did not seem to be planning to run away.

Case reference: 2019015560.CaseDesc: On March 26, 2019, Donna Paré was reported missing in Montreal, Quebec. Donna last communicated with her family in December 2018, and is known to live a transient lifestyle. She is known to frequent the Berri-UQAM and Place-des-Arts metro stations, and the McDonald’s on Sainte-Catherine Street East and Berri Park in Montreal, Quebec. Donna’s family has reason to fear for her health and safety.

Case reference: 2015066998.CaseDesc: Yvon Shawn Guignard relocated to the northern part of Manitoba during the summer of 2015 in pursuit of employment opportunities, with a particular interest in Churchill, Manitoba and the Northwest Territories. While in Thompson, he adopted a transient lifestyle, living in his vehicle and developing friendships within the homeless community. Yvon was last seen on November 28, 2015, at around 6:45 a.m. A number of attempts to give away his personal vehicle were made by him just prior to his disappearance. The vehicle was located at the time he was reported missing. According to his family, he suffers from schizophrenia and has a history of not taking his prescription medication. Yvon has been known to travel to undisclosed locations within the country and act secretive with family as to his whereabouts.

Case reference: 2006009799.CaseDesc: On May 25, 1974, Francis Foster, Robert Warren and another friend departed for a canoe trip on Basswood Lake, Quetico Park, 45 miles (72 km) south of Atikokan, Ontario. It is believed that the canoe overturned and all three are presumed drowned.

Case reference: 2014004923.CaseDesc: On July 24, 1973, Robert Chaple was reported missing. Robert was last seen arriving at his home in Erickson, Manitoba on July 11th in the early morning hours.

Case reference: 2024022203.CaseDesc: On May 7 2024, Lorraine Popowich was reported missing after going missing while searching for cattle on her property located northeast of Athabasca County (Deep Creek), Alberta. Despite extensive efforts, she could not be located. Multiple searches were conducted of the surrounding area over the next several months, but no evidence of Lorraine was found.

Case reference: 2016064545.CaseDesc: On May 17, 2007, skeletal remains of a man were discovered in a farmer's field near the Athabasca River, in Alberta. It is possible that these remains came from the river. This individual did not have any upper teeth and likely wore dentures. The sacrum was deformed and there is a possibility that he walked with a limp.

Case reference: 2012020055.CaseDesc:
The body of an Asian male was discovered by cleaning staff at the Northbrook Inn in Grand Rapids, Manitoba.  The individual had checked in at 15:30h after arriving on the bus from Winnipeg.  At 18:00h cleaning staff entered the room to find the occupant deceased in a chair.
It was learned that the subject checked into the hotel under the name "CHERON, Deoung".  A small black bag containing herbal medication was located in the room, which after translation from Korean revealed the prescription was issued to "PARK, Seng Dae"(variation of spelling PARK, Sang Dae).  It should be noted that the bus ticket-stub was located with the deceased identified "DUNG" as the individual who purchased the ticket.
Numerous checks were made with variety of agencies in an attempt to determine the man's identity.  It is believed he may be of Korean or Chinese decent.

A pair of nail clippers was also found nearby. His death is estimated to have occurred in the spring or summer prior.

Case reference: 2014003215.CaseDesc: On June 24, 1972, a group of seven people, including Hank Ethier, were fishing on the Burntwood River. Hank jumped from his boat and swam to the second one. Once they reached the disabled boat everyone was told to get in. Both boats encountered the rapids. It is assumed Hank drowned as a result of the mishap.

Case reference: 2014006270.CaseDesc: On September 25, 2013, Daniel Pierre was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec. During the time of his disappearance, Daniel was driving a rented 2014 black Jeep Grand Cherokee, and was accompanied by his reddish brown, with a white chest, male pit-bull. The vehicle was subsequently located on the corner of Deguire Boulevard and Ashton Street in the Ville Saint-Laurent neighbourhood in Montreal. Daniel is a diabetic and depends on medication that is not in his possession.
